# Commit map: hashes before and after the 2026-10-28 author-email rewrite

On 2026-10-28 the history was rewritten to replace the owner's work email with a personal one. Nothing else changed: every file, message and date is identical, and each commit's tree is byte-identical. The commit hashes changed, though, so hashes cited in nodes, reviews, the feed and receipts (for example `be73a66`, the last pre-migration commit) are the **old** ones. Look them up here: the left column is the old hash, the right column the new one.
